_fixture.description: A reader supporting 1.0 meets a 1.3 document using a property and an element type it does not know. It refuses by default, one newer-minor error per unrecognised item at its path (a reader cannot know which minor version introduced what it does not recognise, so no `since`); with bestEffort it would read the rest, ignore the unrecognised key and leave out the unrecognised element, and return three warnings: the two items and the version itself. The key `hyphenate` and type `Callout` are invented for this fixture and are not, and will not become, real names.
